name: Reactivation CRM Agent
name_status: working name; Justin and the Offer session set the public one

2026-11-07: Our goal is to work with you on commission. For the first 90 days of us working together and getting to know each other, we do it on a per-appointment basis, and you only have to pay for the qualified appointments that are generated.
If, after 90 days, we both feel good about it, we can either go to a commission or we can stay on appointment.
We do it based off of not per lead, but per actual appointment that you do.
They put $500 down that goes towards those leads, with a specific, dedicated price for that actual lead.
For the most part, though, we want to do it as a reactivation CRM agent.
There's no cost on our end.

deposit_rule: Credit held against qualified appointments. Each qualified appointment draws its price from it.
price_status: Justin sets it. 100 is a proposal: the deposit then covers five appointments.
low_credit_rule: Top-up requested when the credit can't cover one more appointment.

lead_radar.note: Finds people asking for what the client sells on socials and groups. Uses the client's own keys, never ours.

client_pays.orgo_computer: Their own Orgo plan, or an Orgo payment link in our business name (Invoicing). Starter is $29 a month for one always-on Medium.
client_pays.model: Their own model key (OpenRouter), or Orgo AI credit at cost through Invoicing.
client_pays.texting_and_email: Their CRM's own sending and texting registration.
client_pays.crm: Their own CRM. Without one, their own GoHighLevel account.

we_pay.shared_send_gate: One multi-tenant gate service, fixed, not per client.
we_pay.factory_spec_pass: Only for clients onboarded from a recording, capped by the Factory's budget. A form signup costs nothing.

outreach_rule: Outreach never quotes a price. The $500 and the appointment price live on the signup page and on the call.
